description: Remove the public share link from a file or folder; it stops working immediately. Member access is unaffected. The server asks the user to approve this itself.

confirmed.description: Optional and ignored: the server asks the user to approve this itself. You do not need to send it.

path.description: Absolute remote Drive path whose public link should be removed (must start with '/').

name: drive_share_remove_url
title: Remove public link
